fn take_opaque_types_for_query_response(&self) -> Vec<(Ty<'tcx>, Ty<'tcx>)> {
        self.inner
            .borrow_mut()
            .opaque_type_storage
            .take_opaque_types()
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(k, v)| (self.tcx.mk_opaque(k.def_id, k.substs), v.hidden_type.ty))
            .collect()
    }
